body: AMENDMENT CODE ACCEPTED; one public-doc contradiction remains before exact acceptance. At Resolution.scala:116-117, Conditional Scaladoc still says 'To use the value a caller must pattern-match or ask for whenResolved'. The amended non-case class deliberately has no unapply, and ResolutionSuite now proves pattern extraction does NOT compile. That sentence tells a public reader to use a route the type correctly forbids. Minimal fix only: say callers use whenResolved, or the explicitly loss-named valueIgnoringResolution only when reporting the value-resolution pair. Then format/compile the exact amended SHA. The javap surface is otherwise exactly right: no Product, _1, productElement, copy, or unapply; toString redacts payload; complete has no threshold parameter. No other finding.
